attBesluta.text: Sturdy, functional, and simple to build. The build quality is exceptional—thick fabric and a rigid frame that doesn't wobble. It looks great if you like an industrial aesthetic, but more importantly, although we've only had it for about a month, it feels like a buy-it-for-life kind of product. Highly recommend for the price.
Got rid of the pile of clothes on the floor. It looks more like furniture than a hamper. The frame is rock solid.
Great buy, love perfect for my closet, and me space to walk.
4 sections is perfect. I can finally separate gym clothes from towels. The wooden top is stable for folding.

A good looking storage for laundry. it was a little smaller then expected based on the pictures. Especially the height of the unit is rather low so it doesn’t fit huge amounts of laundry. The handles of the baskets are about 60 cm from the floor. Measurements are correct though so just keep it in mind. It was easy to install (took me about 45 minutes) and the manual was quite clear. All in all I would recommend this if you are looking for a neat way to store laundry and like the design.

These gold stands made my dining table look like a luxury hotel. The tiered design is eye-catching and the glass is thick and sturdy. I used them with pillar candles and the wind protection worked perfectly outdoors. Everyone asked where I got them.

Used these with LED candles for an outdoor dinner and the atmosphere was incredible. The gold hasn't tarnished after several uses and the glass cleans up perfectly. They're versatile enough for both casual dinners and formal events.

I searched forever for centerpieces that were elegant but not fussy—these are it. Modern style works with any decor, easy to set up, and the glass is heat-resistant. No discoloration on the gold after multiple uses. Worth every cent.
Good quality, easy to set up and good fun for adults and kids.

this game is somewhat like volleyball but is actually more tipping, short tipping or blocking the ball, I think it would be pretty good for thinking and reacting fast as volleyball can be pretty intense. overall, it's a great sport for rotating out when you make a mistake.... kids and adults all together, you will love it
Great for family parties. Like the height options. Good quality set. Easy to set up and take down.

We are a volleyball family and this game is a perfect fit. It allows everyone to play, regardless of expertise. All generations have played together and enjoyed it. The game itself is easy to assemble and the bag is well made for keeping it all together.

This net was very easy to put together and set up. The poles are somewhat flimsy considering the center pole got a little bend in it the second time we used it. It doesn't affect the game so it's not a problem yet. It definitely takes at least two to three people to set it up. We set it up in our backyard almost every weekend once the weather is warm. You definitely have to move it around to different places of the yard every time you set it up or the grass underneath will get destroyed. My teenagers and their friends love it and play for hours. If you had younger kids that wanted to play it would be very easy to take out a section of the pole to make it shorter.

This has been a fun addition to our family outdoor time. It did end up with a couple of small tears in it after only a week of use, but that doesn't affect the game (so far). Overall it's a nice set and very enjoyable.

Net is ok quality for the price; volleyball didn't last a day as the stiching let go in one spot. Returning the whole package appears to be the only option for ‹NAMN› service so you may want to invest in a better volleyball right away as this one may explode in your face and cut your game short.
